description: This file contains a database migration class for version 4.3.3 of the OrangeHRM system. It defines schema modifications such as changing column types and removing conflicting foreign keys as part of the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class that performs database schema migrations for OrangeHRM version 4.3.3, including key modifications to tables and foreign key constraints.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration by removing conflicting foreign keys, altering column types for several tables, and re-establishing foreign key constraints.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version identifier of the migration, '4.3.3'.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Identifies foreign key constraints that conflict with schema changes and need to be removed before migration.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Removes foreign key constraints identified as conflicting prior to schema modification.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Re-adds previously removed foreign key constraints after schema changes are applied.
